profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Independent and often wary of unfamiliar people, wolfdogs can have strong prey drives and a tendency to escape. Character varies greatly with wolf ancestry, early socialization and the individual: some remain distant, while others seek familiar people and show a sweet, silly side. Most modern wolfdogs come from wolfdog-to-wolfdog or wolfdog-to-dog breeding.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A variable wolf–dog cross family, often independent and wary of strangers, with strong prey drive and differing social needs.
